limitations: No test-driven parameter selection; these analyses do not upgrade failed primary targets.
Pooled reliability bins are descriptive and mix dependent observations.
PPG/ECG rates both use heuristic peak detection; ECG is not manually adjudicated ground truth.
No external independent cohort or prospective intervention validation.
Wall-clock strata are not validated sleep stages.
Quality thresholds 0.9/0.95/1 and deterministic score dropout 0/10/30% are post-primary engineering stress tests, not a second validation dataset.
